crosssave.disclaimer.title: Beta Mod Disclaimer
crosssave.disclaimer.body: This mod is in beta. It may cause save corruption, item loss, or other unexpected issues. You use it at your own risk.
crosssave.disclaimer.button: I Understand and Accept the Risk
crosssave.disclaimer.config_failed: Unable to save your acceptance. Check the config folder permissions and try again.
crosssave.screen.title: Select Target Save
crosssave.screen.hint: After transfer, you will exit the current save.
crosssave.screen.scroll: Scroll or use Page Up / Page Down: %s–%s / %s
crosssave.screen.save_failed: Saving failed. Try again or cancel.
crosssave.chat.saved: Data saved. Please manually exit this save and enter %s. Items will be restored automatically.
crosssave.chat.arrived: Arrived at %s. Extra items have dropped at your feet.
crosssave.chat.failed: Transfer failed. Returned to original save.
crosssave.chat.usage: Usage: /crosssave save <target save folder> or /crosssave load
crosssave.chat.invalid_folder: Enter the target save folder name, not a path.

crosssave.chat.no_pending: No data is waiting to be restored

crosssave.loading.title: Transferring
crosssave.loading.subtitle: Please do not close the game

crosssave.chat.manual_fallback: The automatic switch did not finish. Your data has been kept. Please manually exit and enter %s. Your items will be restored automatically.
crosssave.chat.rollback_failed: Could not automatically reload the original save.
crosssave.settings.title: Settings

crosssave.chat.transfer_cancelled: Transfer canceled. Your original items have been restored. You can select a target save again.
